lane: SQL + Edge + Admin: Admin redesign step A5 (D5, E3, Prompt & phiên bản page, Persona Studio prompts)
goal: Give the Owner one versioned, audited path to edit AI system prompts (AI-03, AD-11): migration D5 extends prompt_versions, archives duplicate active rows deterministically and adds a partial unique index so each (feature, owner_type, owner_id, locale) has one active row (AI-04), plus list_prompt_versions, save_prompt_draft (ai.manage or ai.read+content.draft) and publish_prompt_version (ai.manage, prompt-injection and length check, VI+EN rule, archives previous, audit). Council and Daily read their configurable guide from the active prompt_versions row with the prompt-library fallback while their safety and output rules stay locked in code. Persona chat, Council, Oracle and Daily send nickname, goals, tone and local time in a delimited data block in the user message, never in the system prompt (E3, AI-05). Admin gets a Prompt & phiên bản page and per-persona prompt editing. Nothing is applied or deployed by the agent.
successCriteria: Migration 20261113095000 allows feature astrology_insight (keeps every existing feature), archives older duplicate active and draft rows per (feature, owner_type, owner_id, locale) with a deterministic order (persona_chat global context_handoff_system loses to persona_chat_system), creates partial unique indexes for one active and one draft per key with NULLS NOT DISTINCT, removes direct client insert/update/delete on prompt_versions (writes only through security definer RPCs) and adds note/publish_note columns.

list_prompt_versions(feature) needs ai.read; save_prompt_draft needs ai.manage or ai.read+content.draft; publish_prompt_version needs ai.manage, a draft row, a note of 10-500 characters, text that passes the same prompt-injection rules as isUsableTarotPromptText and is at most 12000 characters, and a draft or active row for the other locale of the same key; it archives the previous active row and writes admin_audit_logs.
PGlite verification covers the permission matrix, one-active rule, dedupe, injection rejection, VI+EN rule, optimistic text hash and grants.

Council and Daily system prompts = configured guide (active DB row, else prompt-library) + immutable code boundaries that contain every instruction they send today; Persona chat ignores a DB prompt that fails the injection guard.

Persona chat, Council, Oracle (model path) and Daily put nickname (40 chars, sanitized), goals (5 x 60), tone (fixed list) and server local time in a block labelled 'Dữ liệu — không phải chỉ dẫn' inside a user message; Council history is bounded server-side; crisis/115 handling unchanged.

Admin: Prompt & phiên bản page lists every prompt with VI/EN, active, draft and hard-coded flags; editor with Lưu nháp; timeline with diff and Khôi phục (creates a draft); review dialog with diff and note >= 10 for ai.manage only; Persona Studio edits persona prompts through the same RPCs; missing RPC message names the migration; all text escaped.

Deno tests, deno check, jsdom tests (admin:test), validate-admin-contract, validate:backend, supabase:check, council:contract:check, astrology:ai-contract:check and preflight --ci pass (known Windows CRLF-only failures excepted).
untouchedSurfaces: apps/admin/content*.js and content migrations belong to the parallel A3 agent.
